title: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: Features Carried by Each Unit Class
content:
**Rule.** Each unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries the features listed for it and no others: the class's temperature band, the class's humidity control, an individual door alarm where the class includes one, gate access during the class's access hours, and parking at the door where the class has drive-up access. A tenant who needs a feature their class lacks is offered a transfer to a class that has it under the transfer rule. A reading outside a class's temperature or humidity band is logged by the facility as a work order; it does not change the rent, and damage it causes is a matter for the tenant's Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan or own insurance.

## Condition and result

| Situation | Result under this rule |
|---|---|
| tenant needs a feature the class does not list | a transfer to a class that has it is offered, under the transfer rule |
| temperature or humidity reading outside the class band | logged by the facility as a work order; the rent is unchanged |
| damage caused by such a reading | a matter for the tenant's protection plan or own insurance |

## Point of judgement (hypothetical)
A tenant of a Bluegate Interior Standard unit who wants drive-up access is offered a transfer to a class with drive-up access; the Interior Standard agreement itself does not gain the feature.
